label: CERB begins
description: CERB eligibility periods ran from March 15 to September 26 2020. Eligibility dates are distinct from application deadlines.

label: CRB begins
description: CRB eligibility periods ran from September 27 2020 to October 23 2021. This was a separate program with its own eligibility rules.

label: CRB eligibility ends
description: End of the last CRB eligibility period; not the date when all emergency support ended. These charts do not identify a policy effect.

label: ODSP rates increase
description: ODSP allowance rates increased by 5% in September 2022. Dates here mark policy context rather than estimated causes of changes in cases.

label: ODSP inflation adjustment
description: ODSP allowance rates increased by 6.5% in July 2023 following inflation indexing. The project pandemic phase is not a benefit eligibility window.
